text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Stakes is 1,800 meters... But

compared to the races to come, it's on
the shorter
side!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With this speed of mine, I should be
able to finish
it in no time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've got this win in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll win this, and then go for the Satsuki
Sho. And
after that, it's the Japanese
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is just me getting my feet wet
before the
Classics! I just gotta give it
my all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have certainly not forgotten! To get
the results I
want, I need to focus on
sprints this year, right?
choice_data_list: 結果次第では……忘れてないな？
結果次第では……忘れてないね？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I have no doubts! There's no way I
will lose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You better look forward to seeing my
victory lap!
